Our services

Land work with a clear finish line.

Three services. One standard: show up, do it right, leave it clean.

01

Stump Grinding

That stump isn't going anywhere on its own. We grind stumps below grade so you can mow, plant, or build right over them — roots, mulch, and mess handled.

Get a free estimate for this service →

What affects your estimate

  • Stump diameter and how many stumps
  • Tree species (hardwoods take longer)
  • Accessibility — can our equipment reach it?
  • Whether you want the grindings hauled off or left as mulch
How deep do you grind?

Below grade — deep enough to mow, plant, or build over. Tell us your plans for the spot and we'll grind to suit.

Do you remove the roots too?

We grind the stump and major surface roots. The remaining root system decays naturally underground.

Do I need to do anything before you arrive?

Yes. The landowner must call 811 before any work so underground utilities can be marked. It's free and typically needs about 3 business days of lead time, so please call at least 3 business days before your scheduled work date. Work cannot begin until utilities are marked.

02

Forestry Mulching

Overgrown acreage, fence lines, and underbrush — cleared in place and turned into mulch that feeds the soil. No hauling, no burn piles, no mess left behind.

Get a free estimate for this service →

What affects your estimate

  • Acreage and density of growth
  • Terrain — slopes and wet ground slow the work
  • Size of trees and brush to be mulched
  • Whether select trees need to be preserved
What happens to the debris?

It becomes the mulch. The mulcher shreds brush and small trees in place, leaving a clean layer of mulch — nothing to haul off.

Will it damage the trees I want to keep?

No. We mulch around the trees you want to preserve — just mark them or walk the property with us first.

Do I need to do anything before you arrive?

Yes. The landowner must call 811 before any work so underground utilities can be marked. It's free and typically needs about 3 business days of lead time, so please call at least 3 business days before your scheduled work date. Work cannot begin until utilities are marked.

03

Bush Hogging

Fields, pastures, and lots that got away from you — cut back under control. One-time cleanups or recurring cuts to keep your land in shape.

Get a free estimate for this service →

What affects your estimate

  • Acreage to be cut
  • Height and thickness of growth
  • Terrain and obstacles (ditches, stumps, debris)
  • One-time cleanup vs. recurring service
How tall of growth can you cut?

If our brush hog can get through it, we can cut it — tall grass, thick weeds, and heavy brush are exactly what it's built for.

Do you offer recurring cuts?

Yes. We'll set a schedule that keeps your fields and lots maintained year-round.

Do I need to do anything before you arrive?

Yes. The landowner must call 811 before any work so underground utilities can be marked. It's free and typically needs about 3 business days of lead time, so please call at least 3 business days before your scheduled work date. Work cannot begin until utilities are marked.
